subject: Warm pass: NovaCorps launch — steward, timeline, and red flags
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorps.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorps.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm pass: NovaCorps launch — steward, timeline, and red flags

Hi team,

Closing notes + quick handoff for NovaCorps (DEAL-4982). Wanted to capture the known constraints and a proposed steward for kickoff next week. Details below — short and tactical.

Deal summary (one-liner): NovaCorps will use Redwood Dedicated (2x A100-equivalent) for real-time summarization and embeddings across 3 internal products (Search, Insights, Inbox). ARR ~ $720k annualized; expected go-live pilot = 2028-05-10.

Key contacts (external):
- Emily Tran — Product Lead — emily.tran@novacorps.com
- Procurement — procurement@novacorps.com (PO expected by 2028-04-25)

Must-have acceptance before go-live (we agreed):
1) Staging API keys + sample dataset (PII scrubbed) available to Redwood by 2028-04-27.
2) End-to-end latency 95th <= 400ms for 1024 token context on Dedicated (we'll build canary tests).
3) Data residency must remain in us-west region per their legal (no cross-region replication).

Known risks / flags:
- Procurement requested a pricing exception (see attached pricing-exception-approvals.pdf). Legal ok'd basic terms but Finance flagged the 12-month commit floor — CS should expect billing gating until PO arrives.
- Their engineering team requires a VPC peering template and a short network diagram; attached novacorps-network-diagram.png is what they shared.
- We have an SLO request for sub-300ms on certain call patterns if they enable caching; we should scope caching rules during kickoffs.

Suggested steward & first asks:
- Steward: Karthik Iyer (CS Lead) — will own kickoff and technical intake.
- Secondary owner for billing/ops: Marissa Cole (CS Ops) — owns procurement hand-holding and environment provisioning tickets.

Immediate next steps (please action):
1) Karthik: confirm steward acceptance and suggest 60/90 minute kickoff slots (I proposed 2028-04-20 or 2028-04-22) and call owners to include infra + a security contact.
2) Marissa: open internal ticket for Dedicated provisioning and attach the SOW (NovaCorps_SOW_v3.pdf).
3) Emily: confirm PO ETA and staging credentials cadence.

Attachments: NovaCorps_SOW_v3.pdf, novacorps-network-diagram.png, pricing-exception-approvals.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on the kickoff if useful, but handing to CS to own delivery.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorps.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm pass: NovaCorps launch — steward, timeline, and red flags

On Tue, Apr 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Closing notes + quick handoff for NovaCorps (DEAL-4982). Wanted to capture the known constraints and a proposed steward for kickoff next week.

Thanks Rafael — happy to take stewardship. Quick notes from my side after scanning the SOW and attachments:

Operational / intake asks for kickoff (I'll own):
- Environment: need staging credentials with a sample collection (<= 10k docs) by 2028-04-27. Please ask Emily to share a Google Drive folder or S3 pre-signed link.
- Security: we need their SOC2 point-of-contact and the list of allowed IPs for peering. Emily, please include the security contact in your reply.
- Acceptance: define 3 acceptance tests (search quality, latency profile, embedding similarity baseline). I'll draft those and share a PR to the shared doc within 48 hours.

Operational risks I want to call out:
1) PO timing — if PO slips beyond 4/25 we'll need an exception to provision staging before billing is cleared. Marissa, can you confirm Finance escalation path?
2) VPC peering — Novacorp's infra team uses strict ACLs; peering may require a short maintenance window. If peering is blocked we can offer API tunnel for pilot but note higher latency.

Proposed kickoff times (PST):
- Wed 2028-04-20 10:00–11:00
- Fri 2028-04-22 14:00–15:30

I'll set a prep doc and include initial acceptance tests + an ingestion checklist. Marissa, please create the provisioning ticket and link the SOW. Rafael — if you have any additional negotiated concessions (billing credits, free pilot quota) flag them so I can include in the runbook.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm pass: NovaCorps launch — steward, timeline, and red flags

Thanks — I'll do the provisioning work and engage Finance.

Action items I'm taking now: 
- Opened internal ticket CS-2028-1138: Dedicated provisioning + canary config. ETA for staging cluster: 2028-04-26. I'll attach SOW and the network diagram.
- Finance contact: looping in FinOps to review pricing-exception-approvals.pdf. If PO delayed, I will request a one-time staging waiver and document the risk.
- Kickoff invite: Karthik, Rafael — I'll block Wed 2028-04-20 10:00 and Fri 2028-04-22 14:00 tentatively and send final once Emily confirms.

Two quick questions for Emily (copying Rafael):
1) Will staging data be scrubbed by Novacorp or do you want Redwood to run the scrubbing pipeline?
2) Who on your side owns the SOC2 artifact sharing? We need an email for the upload and an expected SLA for artifacts (48 hours ideal).

I'll attach the ticket link in a follow-up once created.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole | CS Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: CS-2028-1138 (internal ticket), will link NovaCorps_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@novacorps.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novacorps.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm pass: NovaCorps launch — steward, timeline, and red flags

Thanks Rafael — and hi Karthik & Marissa. Appreciated the clear notes. Quick replies from Novacorp: 

- PO ETA: procurement is on track for 2028-04-25, I'll reply if anything slips.
- Staging data: we'll provide a scrubbed sample set (S3 presigned link) by EOD 2028-04-24. If Redwood prefers we can run your scrubbing pipeline instead — which would you prefer for speed?
- SOC2 contact: Lucy Park (security@novacorps.com). She will upload artifacts to the shared drive; expect a link within 48 hours after request.
- VPC peering: infra is fine with the diagram attached; they asked if Redwood can provide a CIDR whitelist template.

Kickoff: Wed 2028-04-20 10:00 PST works for our team — please send calendar invite. We expect the pilot to be limited to 2 models & 1M doc embedding cap for the first 30 days.

Let us know if you need anything else pre-kickoff.

— Emily
Emily Tran | Product Lead | NovaCorps
Attachment referenced: S3 sample link (sent in separate email)
